items.label: Parking Brake
items.info: Center Pedestal. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.

items.label: All Switches
items.info: All panels. Verify all switches off before applying battery power.

items.label: Circuit Breakers
items.info: Lower panel. All breakers pushed in.

items.label: Landing Gear Switch
items.info: Center panel. Confirms the gear handle matches the weight-on-wheels state before power-up.

items.label: Trim Tabs
items.info: Center pedestal. Elevator, rudder, and aileron trim all set to neutral before start.

items.label: Fuel Selectors
items.info: Center pedestal. Each engine feeds from its respective main tank. Always use mains for start.

items.label: Battery
items.info: Left panel. ON.

items.label: Alternators
items.info: Left panel. Arms both alternators to charge the battery once engines are running.

items.label: Fuel Gauges
items.info: Main panel. Verify operation and quantity. Fill main tanks to 100% before using aux tanks.

items.label: Landing Gear Lights
items.info: Main panel. Three green lights confirm all gear are down and locked.

items.label: NAV Light
items.info: Left panel. Position lights on wingtips and tail. Left on throughout the flight.

items.label: Avionics Master
items.info: Center panel. Kept off during start to protect sensitive avionics from voltage spikes.

items.label: Aux Fuel Pumps
items.info: Center pedestal. Verify both aux fuel pumps off before start.

items.label: Mixtures
items.info: Center pedestal. Both mixture levers full forward for maximum fuel flow during start.

items.label: Propellers
items.info: Center pedestal. Both prop levers forward for fine pitch and maximum RPM governing.

items.label: Throttles
items.info: Center pedestal. Cracked slightly open.

items.label: Cowl Flaps
items.info: Center pedestal. Handles pushed in = fully open.

items.label: Beacon
items.info: Left panel. Red anti-collision light on before engine start to warn ground crew of imminent spool-up.

items.label: Magnetos
items.info: Left panel. Both switches to BOTH for dual ignition on each engine.

items.label: Left Engine
items.info: Left panel. Select LEFT primer, hold starter button until engine fires, then set aux fuel pump to LOW.

items.label: Right Engine
items.info: Left panel. Select RIGHT primer, hold starter button until engine fires, then set aux fuel pump to LOW.

items.label: Throttles
items.info: Center pedestal. Set both to idle range and let oil pressure stabilize.

items.label: Oil Pressure
items.info: Main panel. Must show minimum 10 PSI within 30 seconds of start or shut down immediately.

items.label: Avionics Master
items.info: Center panel. Power up radios and GPS once voltage is stable.

items.label: Avionics & GPS
items.info: Center panel. Program frequencies, set GPS flight plan, verify navigation sources.

items.label: Transponder
items.info: Center panel. Dial in assigned squawk code but leave in standby until ready for taxi or takeoff.

items.label: Altimeters
items.info: Main panel. Set the local altimeter setting from ATIS or tower.

items.label: Taxi Lights
items.info: Left panel. Illuminates the taxiway ahead.

items.label: Mixture
items.info: Center pedestal. Leaning during taxi prevents spark plug fouling from over-rich ground operations.

items.label: Parking Brake
items.info: Center pedestal. Release and begin taxi, checking brakes and steering.

items.label: Flight Controls
items.info: Yoke and pedals. Full deflection in all axes to confirm no restrictions or binding.

items.label: Flight Instruments
items.info: Main panel. Cross-check heading indicator, attitude, and turn coordinator during taxi.

items.label: Parking Brake
items.info: Center pedestal. Hold the aircraft firmly for the high-power engine checks.

items.label: Mixtures
items.info: Center pedestal. Full rich or leaned for field elevation before run-up power.

items.label: Propellers
items.info: Center pedestal. Fine pitch for maximum RPM during magneto checks.

items.label: Throttles
items.info: Center pedestal. Run-up power for magneto and system checks.

items.label: Magnetos
items.info: Left panel. Max 150 RPM drop per mag, max 50 RPM difference between L and R.

items.label: Propellers
items.info: Center pedestal. Cycle to feather (1200 RPM), then back to full forward. Confirms governor operation.

items.label: Engine Instruments
items.info: Main panel. All indications within green arcs before returning throttles to 1000 RPM.

items.label: Vacuum System
items.info: Main panel. Verify 4.75–5.25 inHG.

items.label: Alternators
items.info: Left panel. Amp meter selector to each alternator position. Verify positive load, confirming each alternator is charging the bus.

items.label: Fuel Selectors
items.info: Center pedestal. Confirm both selectors on their respective main tanks for takeoff.

items.label: Flaps
items.info: Center console. UP for normal takeoff, 15 degrees for short field.

items.label: Trim Tabs
items.info: Center pedestal. Elevator, rudder, and aileron set for takeoff position.

items.label: Aux Fuel Pumps
items.info: Center pedestal. Aux pumps ON for takeoff.

items.label: Pitot Heat
items.info: Left panel. Prevents pitot icing that would corrupt airspeed readings.

items.label: Alternate Air
items.info: Right of center console. Verify alternate induction air controls are in the normal (IN) position before takeoff.

items.label: Anti-Ice
items.info: Left panel. Activate engine and prop anti-ice if flying into visible moisture near freezing temperatures.

items.label: Transponder
items.info: Center panel. Switch from standby to active for ATC radar identification.

items.label: Landing Lights
items.info: Left panel. Visibility for traffic avoidance during takeoff and climb.

items.label: Strobes
items.info: Left panel. White high-intensity strobes for traffic visibility on the runway.

items.label: Throttles
items.info: Center pedestal. Both levers smoothly to full forward. Check manifold pressure and RPM matched.

items.label: Brakes
items.info: Rudder pedals. Release toe brakes and begin the takeoff roll.

items.label: Rotate
items.info: Vr varies by weight: 71-82 KIAS (flaps up) or 65-72 KIAS (flaps 15). Lift off at V50 = Vr + 10.

items.label: Gear
items.info: Center panel. Retract as soon as a positive rate of climb is established.

items.label: Climb Power
items.info: Center pedestal. At ~500 ft AGL, set 2500 RPM then 24.5 inHG. Reduce props first, then manifold pressure.

items.label: Climb Speed
items.info: Lower the nose and accelerate from V50 to normal climb speed.

items.label: Gear
items.info: Center panel. Confirm gear retracted and no warning lights illuminated.

items.label: Flaps
items.info: Center console. Confirm flaps fully retracted for clean climb configuration.

items.label: Cowl Flaps
items.info: Center pedestal. Pushed in = fully open. Keep open during climb to maintain cylinder head temperatures in the green.

items.label: Mixtures
items.info: Center pedestal. Lean to climb fuel flow per the performance chart.

items.label: Landing Lights
items.info: Left panel. Retract the landing lights once above traffic pattern altitude to reduce drag.

items.label: Altimeters
items.info: Main panel. Set to standard pressure (29.92 / 1013) passing the transition altitude.

items.label: Aux Fuel Pumps
items.info: Center pedestal. Activate above 12,000 ft to compensate for reduced atmospheric pressure on fuel flow.

items.label: Oxygen
items.info: Cabin. Required above 12,500 ft for crew. Supplemental system if installed.

items.label: Power
items.info: Center pedestal. Typical settings: Max ~75% (24.5 inHG / 2500 RPM), Normal ~60% (23 inHG / 2300 RPM), Long Range ~40% (19 inHG / 2100 RPM).

items.label: Mixtures
items.info: Center pedestal. Lean to EGT peak or target cruise fuel flow for altitude.

items.label: Cowl Flaps
items.info: Center pedestal. Close (pull out) once CHT is stable in the green. Open if temps climb.

items.label: Fuel Selectors
items.info: Center pedestal. Use mains until ~32 gal (~60%) remains in each, then switch to aux tanks one engine at a time with several minutes between switches.

items.label: Aux Fuel Pumps
items.info: Center pedestal. LOW during tank switching. Otherwise off unless fuel flow fluctuates.

items.label: Cowl Flaps
items.info: Center pedestal. Open enough to maintain engine temps in the green during reduced power.

items.label: Power
items.info: Center pedestal. Reduce gradually. Target ~1000 fpm above 10,000 ft, ~500 fpm below.

items.label: Speed
items.info: Maintain 170 KIAS or below Vno for smooth speed management into the terminal area.

items.label: Altimeters
items.info: Main panel. Set local pressure passing the transition level. Verify against ATIS.

items.label: Fuel Selectors
items.info: Center pedestal. Switch back to main tanks for approach and landing.

items.label: Aux Fuel Pumps
items.info: Center pedestal. Aux pumps ON for approach.

items.label: Landing Lights
items.info: Left panel. Extend and illuminate for traffic visibility in the terminal area.

items.label: Alternate Air
items.info: Right of center console. Confirms alternate air controls in normal position.

items.label: Propellers
items.info: Center pedestal. Full fine pitch for go-around capability at any moment.

items.label: Mixtures
items.info: Center pedestal. Full rich or leaned appropriately for field elevation.

items.label: Speed
items.info: Begin slowing to allow gear and flap extension within their speed limits.

items.label: Flaps
items.info: Center console. First notch of flaps. Vfe for 15 degrees is 158 KIAS.

items.label: Gear
items.info: Center panel. Extend below 138 KIAS. Confirm three green lights.

items.label: Flaps
items.info: Center console. Full flaps for landing. Vfe is 138 KIAS. Set on base or within 1 NM on instrument approach.

items.label: Speed
items.info: Vref varies by landing weight: 82-93 KIAS. Stabilize on final approach speed.

items.label: Landing Gear
items.info: Center panel. Final confirmation of three green gear-down-and-locked lights before threshold.

items.label: Throttles
items.info: Center pedestal. Slowly retard at ~30 ft AGL. Maintain slight power until touchdown, then idle.

items.label: Strobes
items.info: Left panel. No longer on an active runway.

items.label: Taxi Lights
items.info: Left panel. Illuminate the taxiway for the taxi to parking.

items.label: Landing Lights
items.info: Left panel. Retract and power off. Not needed on the taxiway.

items.label: Transponder
items.info: Center panel. No longer needed once clear of the active runway.

items.label: Flaps
items.info: Center console. Retract to prevent ground damage during taxi.

items.label: Cowl Flaps
items.info: Center pedestal. Pushed in = fully open. Allows engines to cool during taxi to parking.

items.label: Parking Brake
items.info: Center pedestal. Hold the aircraft at the gate.

items.label: Aux Fuel Pumps
items.info: Center pedestal. No longer needed with engines about to stop.

items.label: Avionics Master
items.info: Center panel. Power down radios and GPS before cutting battery.

items.label: Throttles
items.info: Center pedestal. Confirm at idle detent before mixture cutoff.

items.label: Mixture
items.info: Center pedestal. Pull both mixture levers to cutoff. Starves engines of fuel for a clean shutdown.

items.label: Magnetos
items.info: Left panel. Both switches to OFF after props stop turning.

items.label: Battery & Alternators
items.info: Left panel. Master battery and both alternator switches off.

items.label: Fuel Selectors
items.info: Center pedestal. Fuel selectors OFF.

items.label: Control Locks
items.info: Yoke and pedals. Install control locks.

description: A proven light twin with retractable gear, counter-rotating props, and tip tanks, delivering serious cross-country capability.
